newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese fleeing Congo fighting arrive in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese fleeing Congo fighting arrive in Beirut.

text.p: A group of 150 Lebanese nationals escaping the week-long political and ethnic fighting in Congo's capital Brazzaville arrived in Beirut on Wednesday.
"An Air Congo plane arrived before noon via Luxor in Egypt carrying 150 Lebanese, mainly women and children," a Beirut Airport official said.
According to passengers, most of the 400 Lebanese living in Brazzaville have left the troubled capital to neigbouring West African countries or to Europe.

Battles between forces supporting President Pascal Lissouba and militia warriors loyal to former Marxist ruler Denis Sassou Nguesso appeared on Tuesday to be spilling out of Brazzaville into areas that have been relatively calm.
Earlier this month, more than 1,000 Lebanese nationals who escaped a coup in Sierra Leone were flown into Beirut.
